Major cold-start frontend readiness speedup: eliminates the startup `agy` subprocess storm that saturated WebView's connection pool, staggers gateway maintenance sweeps, and removes blocking CookieManager disk flushes.

## What's New

- **Cold-Start SWR Disk Cache & Shared `agy models` Single-Flight**: Unified `agy models` execution across `models.mjs` and `login.mjs` with in-flight coalescing and disk caching (`~/.cache/hachimia-agy-models.json`, `~/.cache/hachimia-auth.json`); cold boot returns cached models and login status in milliseconds when local credentials exist and verifies silently after 1.5s, while deferring background `/usage` + `/credits` probes by 4s during the first 8s after gateway boot.
- **Non-Blocking Frontend Boot & Connection-Pool Relief**: Coalesced concurrent read-only `GET /api/login/status` and `GET /api/models` requests inside `api()` so WebView's 6-socket per-origin HTTP/1.1 pool is no longer starved while loading chat history; restored the `setOpen` guard on `renderProvCard()`; made `loadModels()` non-blocking inside `loadSettings()` so `boot()` completes immediately; deferred non-essential settings pre-fetches to 6s and dropped duplicate calls.
- **Staggered Gateway Startup Maintenance**: Split `server.mjs`'s synchronous 150ms post-listen sweep (which collided directly with WebView's initial request wave) into staggered 1500–2400ms idle slices.
- **Native Cookie Deduplication & Deferred Flush**: Deduplicated redundant `applyGatewayCookie` writes in `MainActivity` and moved `CookieManager.flush()` to a 250ms deferred call after `web.loadUrl()` begins once Chromium's in-memory CookieStore confirms the cookie.

Fixed ACP `/compact` & `/autocompact` handling, polished Shise theme inputs and horizontal segmented scrolling, and ported upstream cccodroid PRs #249–#253 covering permission sync, large-module watchdog heartbeats, and devkit/pkg reliability.

## What's New

- **ACP `/compact` & Auto-Compaction Fixes**: Recognizes silent `CHECKPOINT` compaction in `agy 1.5.13+` (estimating and persisting post-compaction context as `~{post}` while preserving false-positive guards when text or tool calls occur); fixes `/autocompact` triggers for non-`/compact` slash commands, enqueues auto-compact at queue front, and forwards full session parameters for `ACP_POOL` reuse.
- **Shise Theme, Hint Row & Horizontal Segmented Scroll (Upstream #250 / #251 / #252)**: Restored the clean dot-separated bottom model hint row; fixed Shise single-line input vertical centering on non-initial tabs and multi-line pill corner clipping, and aligned non-Shise input height with the send button; wrapped Model Picker effort/provider rows and Schedule segmented pickers in horizontal scroll containers.
- **Permission Sync & Idle Race Fix (Upstream #249)**: Fixed missed permission cards during replay reconciliation and background idle `control_request` races.
- **Large-Module Watchdog Safety & Devkit/Pkg Hardening (Upstream #253)**: Made module install/removal async & batched with watchdog heartbeats and cancellable `tar -tzv`; refreshes Guile `.go` cache timestamps after online module install; preserves shared layers still required by installed components or `pkg` packages; disambiguates shared library display names (`lib-*`) client-side; ported streaming `devkit.mjs`, fixed `unxzToFile` exit-code race, added `GBMB` signed-phar protection (absolute `php` wrapper for CLI phars, verbatim copy for library phars) to both `devkit.mjs` and `pkg.mjs`; retains verified base tarballs in `GwRuntime` for `Updater` reuse prior to devkit upgrades.

Full compatibility with the upstream cccodroid component market (61 signed official & community components), native terminal browser/clipboard CLI bridges, 5-skin × 2-theme WCAG contrast fixes, and upstream v0.7.14 stability ports.

## What's New

- **cccodroid Component Market Compatibility**: Connects to the signed official and community component indexes (with mirror fallback). After full ed25519 signature verification and original `MANIFEST` per-file integrity checks, stages an in-place equal-length package prefix relocation (`cc.codroid → ha.chi.mia`) across ELF `RUNPATH`/`PT_INTERP`, scripts, `first-run.sh`, dpkg lists, symlinks, and zip archives (with low-memory chunked rewriting for large binaries), unlocking all 61 components (Chromium, `gh`, Blender, LibreOffice, etc.).
- **Terminal `xdg-open` & Clipboard Bridges**: Ships `xdg-open`, `termux-open-url`, `termux-clipboard-get`, and `termux-clipboard-set` in `app/pre` at the head of `$PATH`, routed over the private socket with foreground-only native confirmation dialogs and redacted audit logging (fixing `gh auth` and similar CLI web-login flows). Also preserves wrap-boundary spaces in the terminal text view so long URLs and commands copy cleanly.
- **5-Skin × Light/Dark Contrast Audit**: Fixed 8 rendering and specificity bugs across all skins, including near-invisible `#lightbox` buttons in Shise Light (`1.13:1`), missing `.btn.danger` fills, `#ctxbar` progress/warning text contrast without clobbering `#ctxq`, `.btn.danger-fill` contrast, Zhuyue tour buttons, and Goucheng/Shise button specificity collisions.
- **Upstream v0.7.14 Stability & Devkit Sync**: Ported all 12 upstream stability fixes (in-app updater signature reads, stale proxy bypass on boot, file/git/schedule edge cases), SONAME-aware base ABI drift checks, and expanded devkit language modules and timezone setup.

Official Google Antigravity 5-hour/weekly quota & AI Credits display, frontend/ACP state-sync fixes, and comprehensive stability upgrades.

## What's New

- **Official 5-Hour / Weekly Quotas & AI Credits**: Queries Gemini and Claude/GPT model-group quotas and exact reset times at zero token cost via `agy --output-format json -p "/usage"` and `"/credits"`; updates the top status bar dynamically by active model group, alongside the quick card, Settings account card, Usage dashboard, and 80%/95% alerts.
- **State Sync & Watchdog Hardening**: Upgraded SSE 15s keepalives to real events with a foreground liveness watchdog (40s half-open reconnect + 20s active-run `/api/state` reconciliation) so foreground bubbles never spin indefinitely; registered ACP idle background bursts in `/api/state` with bounded flush timeouts and process-exit cleanup.
- **Live Tool Updates & Session Preservation**: Streams intermediate `tool_update` events to refresh tool cards in place, renders `cancelled` tools neutrally instead of red errors, and drives thinking/text phase indicators automatically; increased `session/resume` & `session/load` timeouts without silently resetting existing sessions on failure, and persists completed tools/partial output on crash or abort.
- **Broad Stability & Security Fixes**: Includes cross-module fixes across auth, model discovery/pinning, subagents/schedules, security guards/trash transactions, installer/mirror resilience, and upstream 0.7.x UI/gateway ports.

Full Antigravity CLI (`agy`) protocol & UX alignment, fixing cold-start disconnects, context bar overflow, and `/autocompact`.

## What's New

- **Cold-Start & Gateway Stability**: Made Google auth status probing asynchronous, added WebView `CookieManager` flush synchronization, gateway proof retry, and deferred heavy startup maintenance to eliminate cold-start "gateway offline" flashes and 502 errors; fixed device selftest and filtered benign glog stderr noise.
- **Context Bar & Usage Tracking**: Separated single-step `usage_update` occupancy from cumulative turn `promptRes.usage`, skipped legacy dirty rows, and improved `shise` theme contrast; wired ACP token analytics, local billing ledger, history backfill, and subscription tier display (e.g., `Google AI Ultra`).
- **Official `agy` Provider Protocol Alignment**: Hidden incompatible legacy Claude/Anthropic presets in pure Antigravity mode and aligned all 4 official channels (Google personal sign-in, Gemini Enterprise, Google Cloud ADC, Gemini API Key / custom Gemini endpoints); live model fetching via `agy models`, `customModelsConfig` sync, and native Gemini API key testing.
- **Slash Commands, Auto-Compaction & Background Wakeup**: Live sync of `agy` slash commands with descriptions, fuzzy palette search, and `$ARGUMENTS` expansion for custom commands; wired gateway-level `/autocompact` triggers and `/compact` progress feedback; added idle `ACP_POOL` wakeup streaming & persistence, background task tracking/cancellation, subagent cards, and interactive `ask_question` cards.
- **Settings & Quick Sheet Cleanup**: Cleaned legacy Claude/cccodroid copy across Settings, Capabilities, Extensions, and the `+` quick sheet, routing diagnostics to native `agy` commands.

First usable release of hachimia: run the official Antigravity CLI (`agy`) natively on Android with no root, proot, or VM.

## Highlights

- **Native ACP Engine & Persistent Session Pool**: Drives the official Android bionic `agy acp` over JSON-RPC 2.0 with a session-scoped keep-alive pool to avoid per-turn restarts. Prefers `session/resume` (with `knownToolIds` deduplication) to eliminate historical replay loops on long sessions.
- **Full Tool Call & Permission UX**: Fixed `tool_result` contract and JSONL transcript persistence (including `diff` and nested content blocks), `agy` tool summaries, standard permission cards (Allow / Always / Deny), `accept-edits` & `thought_level` propagation, and accurate context usage including cached tokens.
- **Default AGY Monet Dynamic Theme**: Defaults to Material You `shise` (`ss-auto`) with an AGY aurora blue (`#4285f4`) fallback across WebView, native splash, and in-app browser.
- **Self-Update & Release Pipeline**: Migrated APK signature verification, GitHub Releases, notices, and `agy` version checks to `greyoak111/hachimia`.
